title: BigDig Extended
description: This Modpack have a lot of Industrial, Mechanical, and too many things. It's A Fanmade, UNOFFICIAL BigDig Update.
body:
Hello Everyone!!!

This is BigDig Extended Modpack

This Is Fanmade Modpack From 1.5.2 Big Dig Modpack


Protect Legacy Style

We are protect the Legacy BigDig Experience. This Modpack Has Same and Close Mechanics Mods

> We didn't add BigDig world generation yet btw.

New Different Technique Mods

Added More Technique Mods, Not simple, not basic. This modpack is very advanced and good. You can enjoy when you play this modpack.

> Note: Some of mods ha s removed cuz modrinth politicies won't allow that.

About Mods

You can build quarries as well as old style and you can convert some of ores like diamond, iron, gold, etc...

You can use Builcraft, at the same times you can build too many machines or something else with newest mods.

You can weird thing with weird mods such as cobblestone generator and you can do some of basic things or machines with some of mods. For example go to mining.

You can do bigger and advanced builds/machines and you can save energy with that. In the same times, you can transform near roads with lamppost.

You can find and mine many ores and you can build more machines and you can do everything in this modpack!!!!

AND UPDATED MODPACK

Same Modpack but Version NEWEST VERSION!!!
